messages:
marina: Heads up — opened a docs PR to update the model catalog availability table and add guidance on pinning model versions for production. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4821 :sparkles:
aj: Nice. Can you call out the quantized variant caveat for edge runtimes? We saw a ~12% perf reg on the aurora-quant path unless you use the new kernel selector.
sanjay: Also add a note about fallback routing — if a pinned variant is out of capacity it should fall back to the compatible variant and log the reason. Otherwise, customers get 504s.
marina: Good call. Current draft has a short paragraph but I can add a subsection with the exact fallback behavior and an example policy.
leo: For the SDK snippet we should show both a pinned example and an unpinned example. Something like:
```
# pin to a stable model for prod
client.generate(model="aurora-7b@2025-11-02", prompt="..." )
# dynamic (auto-upgrade) example
client.generate(model="aurora-7b", prompt="..." )
```
marina: perfect, will include that. Also re: benchmarks — aj can you confirm the tokens/sec numbers for aurora-7b (pinned vs variant fallback) so I can paste them into the card?
aj: I ran the microbench yesterday. Pinned 7b (fp16) ~720 toks/s on p4d, fallback to aurora-7b-quant ~640 toks/s on the same machine. I'll dump the raw table in the PR.
docs-bot: PR #4821 opened by marina: docs/model-catalog: add version-pin guide + fallback behavior (labels: docs, model-catalog)
marina: thanks aj. I'll add the table and a short explanation of when to prefer pinning vs letting the platform route to variants.
sanjay: One more: update the compatibility matrix row for "aurora-7b-quant-v2" — runtime 3.1 doesn't support its custom attention kernel yet. Mark it as "partial" with a note.
leo: Also found one stale link in the model card to the old quantization guide (docs/old-quant.md). We should replace with the new guide URL and add a redirect in the docs repo.
marina: I'll fix the link and add a redirect. Assigning follow-ups: aj — bench numbers and raw CSV; leo — SDK snippet + link fix; sanjay — exact runtime compatibility sentence; I'll push updates by EOD.
aj: I can do the bench CSV in the next hour.
leo: I can PR the snippet and the redirect after lunch.
sanjay: I'll draft the compatibility text and drop it into the PR for you to copy.
marina: great — if no objections I'll merge after CI + one approval. If anyone sees a substantive wording issue ping me directly. :thumbsup:
aj: LGTM, will review once you add numbers.
leo: +1
sanjay: +1
marina: merging after CI then. thanks all! :rocket:
